prologue: Beyond the charted trade lanes, a signal wakes
Automated warships answer it, but no known faction
Reach the source before it calls something worse.
ending: The First Voice fractures. Its command foundry falls silent.
Across the dead timelines, stars return one by one.
The first transmission repeats without its command:
This time, only your own beacon answers home.
ending_hint: The Last Word is spoken. The sky belongs to the living again.

missions.description: The opening encounter at the source of the unknown transmission.
briefing: The beacon is close. Its defense grid is already
tracking your ship.
Break through and identify whatever is transmitting.

events.comment: Show health bars for the linked guardian enemies.
Finish once the guardian formation has been destroyed.
Safety timeout.

missions.description: A new frozen mission built from Episode 4's ice environment and enemies.
briefing: The guardians are down, but one pulse escaped
into an Ixmucane ice vault.
Break the defense ring and silence the Cryo Warden.

events.comment: Safety timeout after the Cryo Warden encounter.

missions.description: A multi-source ice installation and derelict fleet background authored from JSON.
missions.briefing_title: THE VAULT WAS ONLY A LOCK
briefing: Behind the Warden, an ancient carrier graveyard is waking.
The signal is rebuilding a gate from the frozen hulls.
Cross the lattice and destroy the Gate Engine.

events.comment: Scroll the ice structures and fleet wrecks as authored parallax layers.
Restore Frostgate parallax after the remixed fleet event.
Destroying the link-254 Gate Engine jumps to the otherwise unreachable mission exit.
Freeze the encounter clock and background until the Gate Engine is destroyed.
The Gate Engine's link-254 destruction jump lands here and completes the mission.

missions.description: A volcanic descent through ash, lava, bone caverns, and a living receiver complex.
briefing: The Frostgate dies, but its last pulse tears space open.
Your ship is thrown through before the breach collapses.
Below: a volcanic world wrapped around a living machine.
Find the receiver and burn it out.

events.comment: Drive the rapid surface-to-core descent.
Jump to the destruction sequence when the Receiver Heart dies.
Arm mission completion for the Receiver Heart encounter.
Receiver Heart destruction exit.
Safety timeout after the Receiver Heart encounter.

missions.description: A night jungle infected by the signal, descending through machine roots into the Rootmind nest.
briefing: The dying receiver fired one last seed toward a jungle moon.
Now every creature answers a mind beneath the canopy.
Follow the infected river into the roots and kill it.

events.comment: Cast the jungle in a dark violet night filter.
Arm the Rootmind core's link-254 destruction exit as soon as it awakens.
Show the Rootmind core health bar.
Freeze inside the nest until the Rootmind core is destroyed.
Disable forced event movement while the boss gate is frozen.
The destroyed Rootmind core jumps here to complete the mission.

missions.description: A deep-space pursuit through wreckage, dead stations, a gravity scar, and the artificial Null Core.
briefing: The Rootmind's star-map points beyond the rim.
No star burns there, only wreckage around a man-made void.
Cross the dead system and destroy whatever is feeding it.

missions.description: A false paradise concealed beyond the Black Sun, glitching through coral, garden, asteroid machinery, geode engines, and the Deliani vault.
briefing: The dying core opens a gate around your ship.
Beyond it: blue skies, green gardens, no star.
Every horizon is a wall. Find the machine beneath paradise.

missions.description: SERAPH-0 opens into the buried broadcast cathedral where the First Voice manufactures language from machinery and living red signal tissue.
briefing: SERAPH-0 was not guarding a fleet. It was sealing a mouth.
Below Pale Eden, a machine turns living tissue into orders.
Descend through the transmission. Silence the First Voice.
